title: An agent-facing AX query preserves role, name, and backend DOM identity
description: Fetches the full accessibility tree through each driver's own CDP route, finds a deterministic button, and requires its role, computed accessible name, and backendDOMNodeId to survive the adapter boundary.

driver_skips.chrome_devtools_mcp: take_snapshot exposes stable opaque uid references but intentionally does not reveal the raw backendDOMNodeId
driver_skips.agent_browser: agent-browser snapshot exposes agent refs and role/name text but omits the raw backendDOMNodeId
driver_skips.selenium: the cross-engine Selenium/WebDriver route has no standard accessibility-tree command that returns backendDOMNodeId
